summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly issuance of 353,288.620 Class I shares at $29.08/share for ~$10.3 million under its continuous $5.0 billion private offering, relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The filing also disclosed aggregate NAV of ~$1.648 billion and total Class I issuances of ~$1.765 billion. This is an ordinary unregistered equity sale under Item 3.02, not a special situation; no tender offer, merger, or strategic action is involved. The company simply continues its monthly private placements as part of normal operations.
